pairs: Now tax collectors and sinners were drawing near to him,
so that they might listen to him.
Et ait ad illos parabolam istam dicens:
And he told this parable to them, saying:
et si perdiderit unam ex illis,
and if he will have lost one of them,
nonne dimittit nonaginta novem in deserto,
would not leave the ninety-nine in the desert
et vadit ad illam quæ perierat,
and go after the one whom he had lost,
And when he has found it,
he places it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
he calls together his friends and neighbors,
For I have found my sheep,
Dico vobis quod ita gaudium erit in cælo super uno peccatore pœnitentiam agente,
I say to you, that there will be so much more joy in heaven over one sinner repenting,
who do not need to repent.
Aut quæ mulier habens drachmas decem,
if she will have lost one drachma,
and diligently search until she finds it?
Et cum invenerit convocat amicas et vicinas, dicens:
And when she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors,
For I have found the drachma, which I had lost.’
gaudium erit coram angelis Dei super uno peccatore pœnitentiam agente.
there will be joy before the Angels of God over even one sinner who is repentant.”
et dixit adolescentior ex illis patri:
And the younger of them said to the father,
da mihi portionem substantiæ, quæ me contingit.
give me the portion of your estate which would go to me.’
And he divided the estate between them.
adolescentior filius peregre profectus est in regionem longinquam,
gathering it all together, set out on a long journey to a distant region.
et ibi dissipavit substantiam suam vivendo luxuriose.
And there, he dissipated his substance, living in luxury.
And after he had consumed it all,
facta est fames valida in regione illa,
a great famine occurred in that region,
and he began to be in need.
And he went and attached himself to one of the citizens of that region.
et adhæsit uni civium regionis illius:
And he sent him to his farm,
et misit illum in villam suam ut pasceret porcos.
in order to feed the swine.
Et cupiebat implere ventrem suum de siliquis, quas porci manducabant:
And he wanted to fill his belly with the scraps that the swine ate.
But no one would give it to him.
Quanti mercenarii in domo patris mei abundant panibus,
‘How many hired hands in my father’s house have abundant bread,
while I perish here in famine!
and I will say to him:
jam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus:
I am not worthy to be called your son.
fac me sicut unum de mercenariis tuis.
Make me one of your hired hands.’
Et surgens venit ad patrem suum.
And rising up, he went to his father.
Cum autem adhuc longe esset, vidit illum pater ipsius,
But while he was still at a distance, his father saw him,
and he was moved with compassion,
et accurrens cecidit super collum ejus, et osculatus est eum.
and running to him, he fell upon his neck and kissed him.
And the son said to him:
jam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus.
Now I am not worthy to be called your son.’
Dixit autem pater ad servos suos:
But the father said to his servants:
et date annulum in manum ejus,
And put a ring on his hand and shoes on his feet.
And bring the fatted calf here,
quia hic filius meus mortuus erat,
For this son of mine was dead,
Erat autem filius ejus senior in agro:
But his elder son was in the field.
et cum veniret, et appropinquaret domui,
And when he returned and drew near to the house,
And he called one of the servants,
and he questioned him as to what these things meant.
et occidit pater tuus vitulum saginatum,
and your father has killed the fatted calf,
because he has received him safely.’
and he was unwilling to enter.
‘Behold, I have been serving you for so many years.
And I have never transgressed your commandment. And yet,
et numquam dedisti mihi hædum ut cum amicis meis epularer.
you have never given me even a young goat, so that I might feast with my friends.
Yet after this son of yours returned,
qui devoravit substantiam suam cum meretricibus,
who has devoured his substance with loose women,
you have killed the fatted calf for him.’
and all that I have is yours.
But it was necessary to feast
quia frater tuus hic mortuus erat,
For this brother of yours was dead,
